counterfactual.change: changed bodies[1].vy from 32.67 to 5.0 only; lower-energy trajectory avoids the fast oblique arrival at right wall and no escape occurs in 103 steps

explanation: Body 1 approaches the right arena wall obliquely at ~18.7 m/s (vx~14.7). From step 102 (x~19.057, just inside) to step 103 (x~19.264, overshoot 0.18) it crosses the boundary with identical vx, i.e. no wall impulse/positional correction was applied despite substep movement per substep (~0.023) being far smaller than radius (0.92). Finer dt still fails at same physical time, so it is not a substep-count tunneling issue but a missed high-speed oblique boundary contact that lets the body sail through.
vision_note: The large red body moves rightward and slightly downward near the right edge through steps 100 to 102 while staying inside. At step 103 it punches halfway through the right arena boundary with no bounce or correction.
